payload.instruction: Change the background into a basketball court
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Comparing the source and edit, has the background changed to a recognizable basketball-court playing area, rather than merely a basketball-themed backdrop?
node.criteria: Pass only if the source-to-edit comparison establishes a changed background and the edited background as a whole reads as a coherent basketball playing area, supported by a playing surface and contextual court features. Fail if the background changed to basketball imagery but remains a generic backdrop with isolated equipment or only a narrow floor strip or lone line; also fail if no requested background change is visible. Unknown only if the relevant comparison cannot be assessed.
node.binding: Compare source and edited backgrounds directly; disregard the unchanged foreground person. Assess the scene as a whole. A hoop or balls alone, or a single line on a floor strip, do not establish a court. Do not require a regulation layout or prominent markings if the scene otherwise clearly reads as a court.

response.content: {"status":"fail","evidence":"The background changed from a kitchen to basketball imagery, but the edited scene does not read as a coherent basketball playing area: it shows a dark backdrop, a hoop, basketballs, and only a narrow floor area with a line.","confidence":0.98,"used_dependency_ids":[]}
